usage.callShape: GET https://api.syntalic.com/v1/marketing/promo-intelligence?category=electronics (required query param: category; optional: country=us|ca, brand, aggregate_by=brand|retailer, from, to as ISO dates)
usage.outputShape: untested — outputSchema is generic object; per service description, returns competitive promo/pricing analysis aggregated by brand (or retailer) for the category. Response is JSON (declared output type json).
quirks: category is a REQUIRED query-string param (not a body) — GET request; omitting it 402s/422s.
category is fuzzy human-readable (e.g. electronics, grocery, beauty); resolver maps it to a canonical id via id->exact->trigram->embedding kNN.
Endpoint is x402-paid ($0.01). It returned a VALID, well-formed 402 challenge (Base eip155:8453 USDC accept with full EIP-712 extra, plus two Solana accepts).

COULD NOT COMPLETE PAYMENT via the qa-pay money-safe harness on 2 attempts: harness returned classification 'http-error', paid:false, costUsd:0, txHash:null — its payment flow did not engage on this challenge. No money was lost. This is a payer-side settlement gap, NOT a dead endpoint (no 404/5xx/refund).
Re-test required with a working x402 payer to confirm the paid 2xx body.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.syntalic.com/v1/marketing/promo-intelligence with the required query param ?category=<human-readable category like electronics|grocery|beauty>. Optionally add country (us|ca, default us), brand, aggregate_by (brand default, or retailer), and from/to ISO dates. It is an x402-paid endpoint ($0.01 USDC, settles on Base or Solana). On success expect a JSON body of competitive promo/pricing analysis aggregated by brand (or retailer). NOTE: the QA harness received a valid 402 challenge but could not settle payment, so the paid response shape is unverified — a future agent with a working x402 client should be able to pay and read the JSON result directly.
